title: Enduring Effects of Goal Achievement and Failure Within Customer Loyalty Programs: A Large-Scale Field Experiment
authors: Yanwen Wang; Michael V. Lewis; Cynthia E. Cryder; Jim Sprigg
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single common promotion period (8 months pre, 8 during, 8 after for 95,532 hotel loyalty members); no staggered adoption. Tables 1-5 regress individual pre/post differences in nights, revenue and stays on HIT/MISS and incentive/hurdle arms (cross-sectional OLS, with a propensity score from a logit); Tables 6-7 are random-effects panel Tobit models (xttobit) with time-varying controls.
design_notes: code.txt: R block (glm propensity score for HIT; lm of DIF2_* on HIT or MISS + incentive/hurdle dummies, with and without the score) and Stata block (xtset GUEST_ID period; xttobit nt ... ll(0)). Treatment arms assigned at one date; no unit-specific adoption dates.
data_files_note: Package ships only readme.txt (variable definitions) and code.txt; the analysis files (hurdle_agg.csv and the Stata panel) are not included.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; design read from the OpenAlex abstract, readme and code.
